answer_1.quote: In this paper, we propose to improve the faithfulness of data-to-text neural generators by reducing the number of hallucinations and omissions during the generation process...

answer_2.quote: We considered BLEU, ROUGE, METEOR, BertScore dubbed as BScore, NLI, and RANK.

answer_4.quote: We hired three evaluators from a Faculty of Law that assigned a score between 1 to 10, 1 corresponding to a generation completely off-track, and 10 being a perfect generation.
answer_4.guideline: assigned a score between 1 to 10, 1 corresponding to a generation completely off-track, and 10 being a perfect generation
